fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for bug change set 01M767125EJM98D7H4ME2T67H5. No owner was present. The planner read the bug intent, internal/api/daemon_projects.go daemonMilestoneWaits, internal/api/request.go daemonPlanRequests' milestoneLive, the plan-milestone workflow (interview start step, then autonomous agent and command steps), run.State (Current, Stopped, SignoffWait) and the inbox's interview item (already ends when the interview step ends). Two questions went to the arbiter: which intent the change set serves, and which live milestone plan runs block a queued milestone request. The arbiter's Decision milestone-wait-owner-steps-only: serve milestone-25; block only on an unjournaled start within daemonStartGrace, or a run whose current step is owner-interactive (the interview start step, or a step paused waiting on the owner such as a gate or sign-off under owner autonomy); maxRuns still caps every start. The planner folded the rule into the existing leaf milestone-request-starts-at-once, whose statement said any live milestone run keeps the next one queued.
